current.title: 给日常生活做一张设计
current.prompt: 菜市场、社区活动、家庭小店——选一个你身边的真实场景，做一张海报、图标或一页界面。
current.promptEn: A market stall, a community event, a family shop — pick a real scene near you and make a poster, an icon, or a page.

rules: 一人一票：用 GitHub 账号在作品 issue 上点 👍；一个账号只算一票，可改票。
网站只展示结果，不直接写票；票数由 GitHub Actions 定时同步。
可以给自己的作品拉票，但不能买票、刷号或批量账号投票。
维护者只剔除违规票，不按审美改票。
rulesEn: One person, one vote: tap 👍 on a work's GitHub issue. One account counts once; you can change your reaction.
The site displays results only. Counts are synced from GitHub reactions by a scheduled Action.
You can ask friends to vote for your work, but bought, automated, or bulk-account votes are removed.
Maintainers remove invalid votes; they do not edit votes for taste.
